title: Agent Control Map
subtitle: Who holds the keys of on-chain agent infrastructure. Public data only.

entries.name: ERC-8004 registries (Identity, Reputation, third proxy)
entries.summary: Three upgradeable (UUPS) proxies on six chains share one owner: a plain address that signed the upgrades itself. No ownership transfer since deployment. Project docs recommend a multisig or timelock for production. Question sent to the team; awaiting reply.
entries.verify: Logs: Upgraded 0xbc7cd75a...2d3b, OwnershipTransferred 0x8be0079c...57e0 on each proxy

entries.name: USDC on Base (token under x402 payments)
entries.summary: Proxy admin and owner are plain addresses (no code). The address that can freeze (blacklist) accounts is a plain address that is actively used. The master minter is a contract. Freezing is a standard issuer compliance function; roles other than these not checked.
entries.verify: Logs: AdminChanged, OwnershipTransferred, BlacklisterChanged, MasterMinterChanged on the proxy

entries.name: x402 BatchSettlement and deposit collectors
entries.summary: Verified source on Base: not a proxy, no owner, upgrade or pause functions. Same addresses on Base, Ethereum and Polygon. Trust remains in the payment token and the facilitator.
entries.verify: Contract ABI on the explorer: no owner/upgrade/pause functions

entries.name: Coinbase SpendPermissionManager
entries.summary: Verified source on Base: not a proxy; no owner, upgrade or pause functions in the ABI. Address published in Coinbase developer docs. Control sits with each wallet's owners, who can revoke a permission.
chains: Arbitrum, Avalanche, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon (per docs)
entries.verify: Contract ABI on the explorer; Coinbase docs page on spend permissions

entries.name: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7
entries.summary: Verified source on Ethereum: not a proxy; no owner, upgrade or pause functions. Same address on other chains (not checked).

entries.name: Permit2
entries.summary: Verified source on Ethereum: not a proxy; no owner, upgrade or pause functions. Used by x402 Permit2 collectors.

not_checked: Base, OP, BNB, Gnosis, Avalanche for ERC-8004
other chains for EntryPoint and Permit2
disclaimer: Observations from public on-chain data, not vulnerability reports and not security advice. A plain address means no contract code at that address; how a key is stored cannot be seen on-chain. Corrections welcome.
